# Synthetic sample data

**These files are fake.** They're generated by `scripts/make_sample_data.py` with random values,
in exactly the same layout as the real `data1.xlsx` and `data2.xlsx`, so reviewers can run the
pipeline without access to the restricted source data.

Planted problems, so the quality report shows each rule working:

| File | Problem | Expected action |
|---|---|---|
| `data1.xlsx` | Header reads `China`, one cell reads `Reporter` | Repaired |
| `data1.xlsx` | 1 exact duplicate row | Dropped |
| `data1.xlsx` | 1 negative trade value | Rejected |
| `data1.xlsx` | 1 row with unit `Ton` instead of `Kg` | Rejected |
| `data1.xlsx` | Partner `Peru` has no electricity data | Kept, electricity fields NULL |
| `data2.xlsx` | 1 negative Solar generation | Rejected |

Run: `uv run python scripts/run_pipeline.py --sample`. Result: [docs/quality_report_sample.md](../../docs/quality_report_sample.md).
Real data setup: [docs/setup.md](../../docs/setup.md).
